punchline: Mozart's father wrote out the notes of the early compositions; the first work regarded as a masterwork came at twenty-one.
thirty_sec: The Mozart legend describes a gift that arrived at three. Colvin opens the file: his father Leopold was one of the best-known violin teachers of the period and had his son in systematic training by three at the latest. The handwriting on the early compositions is Leopold's, not Wolfgang's. The first four concertos, at eleven, contain no original music. The first work regarded as a masterwork came at twenty-one.
